profile.design: R copies of every exported trade, starting with K=5R seats in one shared pool. Reuse free seats and buy only the entry-time deficit, subject to 20 live accounts. Purchases cost $200 each and require instant funded-account availability. Initial seat funding and subsequent external cash needs are measured; no affordability gate or Evaluation lead time is imposed. No calendar purchases or inherited future reference survival demand.

capacity.interval_convention: [entry, exit); existing exits first; zero-duration offers enter then immediately exit

base_config.description: Headline. Every Apex payout rule switched on, and our own behaviour is to request $500 -- the firm's minimum -- from each account every calendar month, carrying unpayable months as a backlog.
